description: Marketplace: prepare (unsigned) buying a listing for exactly its ETH price (marketplace_listings shows it). For NFTs pass collection and tokenId; for a weapon pass collection "weapons" and listingId. Refused if the listing is stale, locked or yours.

collection.description: companions, operatives, fighters, crates or portal (or the contract address); or "weapons" for Armory weapons. NOT the Override Disk (Ripples' collection, trades on OpenSea) and NOT mercenaries (locked to the buyer).

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read your balance and allowance and to simulate.

name: prepare_buy_listing
